description: This file defines the ValidityBasedTrustOptions class, implementing TrustOptions, which creates and manages trust options based on certificate validity periods. It is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth package.

classes.name: ValidityBasedTrustOptions
classes.description: Implementing TrustOptions, this class provides trust options that consider certificates valid based on their ‘not before’ and ‘not after’ properties, and returns a custom TrustManagerFactory.

methods.name: ValidityBasedTrustOptions
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the custom TrustManagerFactory.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ValidityBasedTrustOptions, implementing clone behavior from TrustOptions.

methods.name: getTrustManagerFactory
methods.description: Returns the associated TrustManagerFactory, potentially based on the provided Vertx instance.
